newsitem.title: USA: First Albany Cos sees margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: First Albany Cos sees margin pressure.

text.p: First Albany Cos Inc said Friday strong revenues in the second half of 1996 were offset by investment in people and systems and it expected this pressure on margins to continue in the first half of 1997.
But the company said it was optimistic for 1997.
In fiscal 1996, the company reported revenues of $42.7 million, compared to $34.9 million in 1995.
"This year's revenue gain reflects significant increases in both the firm's institutional and retail divisions," Chairman George McNamee said.
